subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the current predicate-script plus fault-injected test proof enough for this agent retry change, or should this PR wait for full-runner or gateway proof before merge?
rationale: The code shape looks narrow, but the touched path controls session replay safety, message delivery, and provider fallback ordering, so proof sufficiency and the exported harness contract need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Require full-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact from a full runner or gateway setup showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects.

options.title: Accept the current proof
options.body: A maintainer may decide the predicate transcript plus fault-injected runner coverage is enough and take responsibility for the remaining runtime-proof gap.

options.title: Change the API shape first
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers do not want the new optional attempt-result field or the server_error retry-before-failover ordering.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact from a full runner or gateway setup showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant recent history shows adjacent terminal/replay work in the same agent-runner area, making this the best available routing owner for proof and contract acceptance.
